meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 将大任务拆成多个可独立合并的小 PR,每个 PR 在自己的工作区并行开发;先手动验收并留证据,再写英文 PR;然后反复跑 CI 和 Cubic 检查(额度用尽才跳过),最后自动合并并清理工作区。
howto.when: 当你要求把代码以 PR 形式交付,例如说“create a PR”“implement and PR”,或你只是说“实现 X”但上下文表明需要提 PR 时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成几个独立的小 PR,分别实现并合并
say.note: 会拆解任务,并行推进每个 PR

say.text: 帮我实现这个功能并走 PR 流程,通过后合并
say.note: 自动执行手动验收、CI/Cubic 检查直到合并

say.text: 按 PR 工作流处理这个任务,最终产出可合并的英文 PR
say.note: 完整走实现、验证、合并与清理流程

howto.what_en: Splits a task into small atomic PRs in separate worktrees, built in parallel. Demands manual-QA evidence, creates an English PR, loops CI+Cubic until green (Cubic skipped only on quota), then auto-merges and cleans worktree.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deliver work as a PR, e.g. 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', or when context implies PR output even for a plain 'implement X'.

say_en.text: Split this issue into independent small PRs and implement them.
say_en.note: The skill decomposes and runs them in parallel.

say_en.text: Implement this feature as a PR and merge after all checks pass.
say_en.note: Runs QA, CI and Cubic until merged.

say_en.text: Handle this task with the PR workflow and produce a mergeable English PR.
say_en.note: Follows full lifecycle with worktree cleanup.
